upstream.package_policy: Exact retained resource bytes, selected by native engine lookup and current canonical source/font coverage; no runtime network package fallback.

font_family_closures.scope: Complete native TFM, VF, Type1, encoding and TeX font-definition files; unchanged, each byte-matched to the retained official complete distribution. No AFM or unused OpenType families.

font_database.description: Retain original upstream metadata for 21 native optical-size Latin Modern Roman faces, four Junicode faces and four FreeSerif OTF faces. Renumber only record IDs in retained source order.

package_sources.derivation: Original Babel 26.3 source reproduces retained native babel.sty and errbabel.def byte for byte when unpacked with Unicode XeTeX docstrip; only local overwrite prompting was disabled. The unchanged English distribution reproduces english.ldf byte for byte. Original locale files remain byte-identical.
